//: FRAGMENT fixture for the KPI SPARKLINE-LIST ROW sub-component — the `.pa-kpi-spark-row` CLEAN BLOCK the kpi-sparkline-list container (kpi-sparkline-list.json) feeds through its body slot and DEFERS to here. Tested in isolation (svelte `display/KpiSparklineRow.svelte` → REGISTRY key kpi-sparkline-row; keen `PureAdmin.Components.KpiSparklineList.kpi_sparkline_row/1` → render/2 + meta/1 key kpi-sparkline-row). Unlike kpi-strip-row (an element-rooted FLAT-SIBLING fragment), this is a real BLOCK (block=`pa-kpi-spark-row`) carrying its own five sentiment modifiers (--up/--up-strong/--flat/--down/--down-strong) caught by the reverse check, with proper __-element children (__label/__chart/__value/__num/__unit/__delta[+ --*]). The container (kpi-sparkline-list.json) owns the --no-delta/--chart-first list modifiers + the card chrome — NOT this fragment. CHART CELL: __chart hosts an author SVG via a slot; both wrappers ALWAYS emit the <div class="pa-kpi-spark-row__chart"> wrapper and render the slot content inside it verbatim, so a PLAIN-TEXT chart token keeps the two SSR shells identical (the real SVG + the JS-generated pa-kpi-spark-wrap/pa-kpi-spark-dot are out of scope — JS-built, never SSR-authored; they stay deferred on the container). Authored from snippets/kpi.html (SPARKLINE LIST section, L339-367) + _kpi-sparkline-list.scss.
goldenConventions: Row element is a <div class="pa-kpi-spark-row [--variant]"> (hover host for the detail popover; the popover is JS-relocated and not SSR-material here when no detail is set). Cell order is fixed and ALL FOUR always render: __label, __chart, __value, __delta. Inside __value: an optional __unit prefix, then __num, then an optional __unit suffix — __num always renders when valueText is set (keen guards __num on value_text, svelte renders it unconditionally, so every scenario sets valueText to keep the two shells identical). The chart cell wraps a plain-text token standing in for the author SVG. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

propsVocabulary.variant: row trend sentiment — pa-kpi-spark-row--{variant}; cascades colour to the chart via currentColor. svelte variant; keen variant.
propsVocabulary.label: uppercase metric name — pa-kpi-spark-row__label. svelte labelText; keen label_text.
propsVocabulary.chart: chart cell content (author SVG sparkline; plain text here) — wrapped in pa-kpi-spark-row__chart. svelte chart snippet; keen :chart slot.
propsVocabulary.value: focal number — the pa-kpi-spark-row__num inside pa-kpi-spark-row__value. svelte valueText; keen value_text.
propsVocabulary.unit: unit suffix after the number — pa-kpi-spark-row__unit (second affix inside __value). svelte unit; keen unit_text.
propsVocabulary.prefix: currency/scale prefix before the number — pa-kpi-spark-row__unit (first affix inside __value). svelte prefix; keen prefix_text.
propsVocabulary.delta: Δ% text — pa-kpi-spark-row__delta. svelte deltaText; keen delta_text.
propsVocabulary.deltaVariant: Δ% sentiment tint — pa-kpi-spark-row__delta--{variant}. svelte deltaVariant; keen delta_variant.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the row (passthrough — svelte class, keen class).

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-kpi-spark-row'). variant's five options are the blessed row sentiment modifiers (--up-strong/--up/--flat/--down/--down-strong). deltaVariant's five options are the blessed Δ% tints (--very-positive/--positive/--neutral/--negative/--very-negative — a DIFFERENT scale from variant). label/value/delta text slots + chart carry element classes. unit/prefix both land in pa-kpi-spark-row__unit (same affix class, before/after __num). __value is a structural wrapper always present (exercised by goldens).

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to the row, not a core feature
